name: oblivia-protocol
description: Oblivia protocol monorepo: Groth16 circuit, Solana program, SDK, relay and reference clients

scripts.setup:test: npm ci && npm --prefix sdk ci && npm --prefix relay ci && npm --prefix zk_groth16 ci
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && npm --prefix zk_groth16 run test:binding
scripts.test:multisig: cd oblivia-contracts && anchor build && cargo test -p oblivia-contracts --test multisig_proof_gate
scripts.test:program: cd oblivia-contracts && cargo check -p oblivia-contracts && cargo test -p oblivia-contracts --test proof_verification
